_authority: AUTHORED. Every mutable cache reachable from assurance code carries an explicit authority classification. An unclassified cache fails closed; a classification whose subject no longer exists fails closed too.
_purpose: Close Gate 4N-I28AP finding ADV-I28AP-03: a mutable memo cache could take release roots 41 -> 0 and production sites 492 -> 0 while every protection layer reported clean.
_volatile_cache_meaning: VOLATILE_CACHE now means mutable, NON-AUTHORITATIVE, and independently recomputed or identity-verified. It does NOT mean mutable state omitted from provenance because binding it is inconvenient — that reading is precisely what ADV-I28AP-03 exploited.
_why_this_file_exists: A cache nothing classifies is a cache nothing stops from deciding. The classification is authored so a reader can check it; the CHECK is derived, because verify() recomputes the authoritative answer from staged source and compares, whatever the classification claims.

cache_authority._PINS.fresh_recomputation: not applicable: it holds identities, not derived answers. verify() recomputes the authoritative taxonomy without consulting it.
cache_authority._PINS.name: _PINS
source_inputs: the live cache objects at the moment they were verified
cache_authority._PINS.value_type: (mapping id, {key: value id}) recorded at pin() time
cache_authority._PINS.why: It records the identities a load-bearing consumer compares against, so emptying it would silently disable assert_pinned(). It is SESSION_BASELINE_STATE rather than a performance hint: its whole purpose is to remember what was true earlier in THIS session, so it legitimately differs between a fresh interpreter and a running one and cannot be content-pinned. It decides nothing on its own — a missing pin makes assert_pinned() a no-op, and the authoritative recomputation in verify() is unaffected, which is why weakening it cannot manufacture a false CLEAN.

shell_command_model._cache.name: _cache
shell_command_model._cache.why: It feeds command-root derivation, so a poisoned entry could in principle suppress a root. It is covered because the fresh taxonomy derivation clears it along with site_taxonomy's caches and re-derives from staged source; a suppressed root therefore shows up as a fresh/served disagreement and fails closed.

site_taxonomy._DERIVED.name: _DERIVED
site_taxonomy._DERIVED.why: THE ADV-I28AP-03 SUBJECT. It is now a hint and not an authority: values are canonical and immutable so nested mutation is impossible, the mapping and every value are identity-pinned so replacement is detected, and verify() derives roots and sites fresh from staged source and refuses on any disagreement.

site_taxonomy._INDEX.name: _INDEX
site_taxonomy._INDEX.why: It feeds the same derivations as _DERIVED. Cleared and re-derived by the fresh path, so a poisoned, stale or cross-tree index produces a fresh/served disagreement and fails closed.

docker_assurance_state._STATE_CACHE.name: _STATE_CACHE
docker_assurance_state._STATE_CACHE.key_type: str (cache_key_digest over the complete Docker assurance identity set)
docker_assurance_state._STATE_CACHE.value_type: frozen {state, state_digest, cache_key_digest, provenance, validation_status, cache_schema_version}
docker_assurance_state._STATE_CACHE.fresh_recomputation: docker_assurance_state.fresh_state()/reverify_state() derive without consulting the cache; cache_authority._suspend_caches() empties it during every fresh authoritative taxonomy derivation
docker_assurance_state._STATE_CACHE.session_finish: signalnest_bootstrap.reverify() freshly re-derives via reverify_state() and never substitutes the cache
docker_assurance_state._STATE_CACHE.content_binding: cache_key binds staged_tree, source_content_token, policy_digest, category_table_digest, normalization_version, parser_schema_version, parser_completion, source_position_version, production_universe_digest, independent_universe_digest, state_schema_version, assertion_contract_digest, and authorization_pair_digest; the value re-validates the state and both digests before reuse
docker_assurance_state._STATE_CACHE.why: It caches the validated authoritative Docker assurance state so a warm session need not re-derive it, but it is AUTHORITATIVE_CONTENT_BOUND_CACHE: every reuse revalidates the complete identity key AND the value's state/digests, and session finish never trusts it. A cross-tree, cross-policy, or retired-authorization entry fails its key; a mutated value fails its digests; and cache_authority suspends it during fresh derivation, so it can never manufacture a false CLEAN.
